text:
Maya R: quick preflight for sprint-42 region expansion — planning to bring up ap-northeast-2 on Thu (2026-03-19). Can owners confirm routing policy changes, KMS/data-residency blockers, and any customer dependencies? cc @eng-infra @eng-security

Samir P: routing PR is up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/routing/pull/834 :eyes: It updates weighted routing + fallback rules. Need eng-infra to open peering ticket and confirm BGP community tags. Also requires a firewall rule (allow 10.8.0.0/24 -> 10.9.0.0/24).

Oliver T: infra can handle capacity. Need exact AZ list (we requested three AZs). What's min/max for autoscale? Also opened ticket CP-9012 for cloud peering contact.

Priya K: security note — KMS policy must include the ap-northeast-2 service account. Confirming no cross-region log shipping for regulated tenants. If any workload writes raw PII to logs we need masking before cutover. Which customers will be routed there?

Jen L: Product: Customers A and B requested AP residency; customer A has contractual residency clause so we must prevent them from hitting EU fallbacks. Add a strict-residency flag to routing for those tenants.

Samir P: will add strict_residency: true for tenant IDs in config. Can legal/ops provide the exact tenant IDs?

Maya R: Legal DM'd a list to me, forwarding to Samir. Marcus (oncall): rolling deploy window Thu 02:00-04:00 UTC, I'll be oncall for cutover.

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: ap-northeast-2 rollout starting 2026-03-19T02:00Z. Track: https://deploys.redwood/internal/rollouts/2389001

Oliver T: small infra ask — healthcheck path for the region should return 200 within 10s for instance types g5/rt1. Please add to infra playbook.

Priya K: also confirm KMS key rotation policy — rotation should be disabled during initial cutover. Audit logs retention: AP customers may need 24 months; will post exact retention numbers.

Samir P: PR updated: added strict_residency flags, healthcheck, and firewall note. @Priya K please review KMS policy change: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infrastructure/pull/210

Priya K: reviewing now. Quick reminder: for tenants with residency restrictions, do not enable any global fallback policies. I'll post the retention matrix for EU vs AP.

Maya R: action items: Samir - finalize PR and config tags; Oliver - peering ticket + healthcheck update; Priya - KMS & audit signoff; Marcus - oncall window. If folks want a dry-run before Thu, propose Wed 18:00 UTC.

Jen L: Wed dry-run works for product team. :thumbsup:

Samir P: scheduling dry-run Wed 18:00 UTC. Runbook snippet below:

```
# dry-run steps
1) deploy routing config to staging-ap
2) run canary with tenant A (strict_residency enabled)
3) verify KMS access and that logs remain region-local
4) validate healthchecks and latency targets
5) rollback if any strict_residency violations or audit issues
```

Marcus (oncall): I'll standby Wed night and will join the canary. Ping me when you start.

Maya R: thanks all — please update your PRs and ping this thread when green. Closing for now, will reopen if blockers appear.
